title: Physical environment-hand accounting repair
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The legacy total_hands marker counter undercounts physical work whenever the trainable seat has no action; independent worker terminal counters can provide complete, checkpoint-safe physical accounting without resetting legacy counters or optimizer state.
material_change: Add an independent completed-environment-hand accounting schema covering no-decision hands and worker tails, persist it in checkpoints/manifests/metrics, preserve legacy total_hands semantics, and add an opt-in physical-hand stopping target with fail-closed handling of unknown legacy prefixes. Audit historical paired evidence as a lower bound without modifying raw artifacts.
baseline: Current train_v5.py marker-only total_hands; paired pilot has 263,479 marker hands but 316,700 emitted source-plus-mirror hand evidence.
source: Existing trainer and immutable paired-seat-average-actor-pilot-20260830 evidence; no policy algorithm change.

notes: No further production training until unit tests and small single/multi/resume smokes verify physical counters include no-decision hands, remain monotone, preserve legacy total_hands and optimizer state, and reject physical-target continuation from an unknown historical prefix. Do not rewrite historical checkpoint/session/hand evidence. Historical physical work may only be reported as an evidence-backed lower bound where exact worker-tail counts are unavailable.

37 tests passed after adding physical counters and a PPO-boundary physical target. No trainer policy/reward/optimizer algorithm was changed. Legacy total_hands is explicitly transition-bearing hands; physical counters include no-decision terminal hands and completed worker tails.

Single smoke passed at 771 physical completed hands, 574 legacy marker hands, 137 no-decision hands, and 60 completed but unconsumed decision-bearing tails. Resume smoke keeps the same checkpoint/optimizer/counters and assignment RNG, uses physical endpoint 1024, and deliberately skips to fixed-deal index 100000 to avoid repeating prior smoke deals. Skipped indices are not counted as hands; this tests accounting continuation, not bitwise uninterrupted rollout equivalence.

The first resume invocation was rejected by parser validation before any worker or file mutation because --no-reset-optimizer was not explicit. Corrected invocation includes --no-reset-optimizer; the preserved-LR guard prevented accidental optimizer reset.
Single resume PASS: physical 771+429=1200, no-decision 137+79=216, legacy 574->851, optimizer step 10->14; prior archive hashes unchanged and assignment chain contiguous/pending null.

The first unknown-prefix probe was stopped earlier by the existing critic_v2 value-coef guard; it did not test the physical-prefix guard and produced no checkpoint. Repeating with the required --value-coef 1.

Corrected unknown-prefix probe reached the intended ValueError after loading the checkpoint optimizer but before worker startup or checkpoint creation. Added a guard that rejects already-completed physical endpoints before creating unused assignment evidence.

Final source snapshot includes the terminal-counter implementation exercised by single/multi/resume smokes and the final prefix-type/completed-endpoint guards exercised by unit/probe checks. Immutable source copies were SHA256-verified against workspace files; final patch SHA256 6a36b02fa8d2cbc072169ae9d9cbe5cedaac29c1c52183d03652c6fadfd3986d.

Historical paired accounting corrected to a physical lower bound of 317800 while preserving legacy markers 264545 and all raw training/evaluation evidence. The central contract is documented in research/HAND_ACCOUNTING.md.

result.summary: Implemented independent physical terminal counters for single/multi workers, verified no-decision and tail accounting, preserved same-checkpoint optimizer/counter continuation, and repaired historical paired-pilot physical-hand labels using immutable lower-bound evidence.
result.conclusion: New runs can budget and report complete local physical environment work. Legacy total_hands remains transition-bearing hands; unknown historical physical prefixes are never guessed, and counter continuity is not claimed to provide bitwise uninterrupted rollout equivalence.
result.next_step: Choose the next learned-policy experiment using research/HAND_ACCOUNTING.md, an immutable pre-run source snapshot, explicit physical-hand budgets, and staged frozen evaluations; do not scale the rejected paired/sampled treatments unchanged.
